requirements.requirement: The system must render a sponsor credibility UI block within the MessageBubble component when sponsor data is present.
The system must display the sponsor name exactly as provided by the transformed data layer.
The system must display the sponsor type (e.g., industry, academic, government) in the sponsor credibility block.
The system must display the funding source label (public, private, undisclosed) as provided by the rendering logic.
The system must display collaborators as a formatted list or string within the sponsor credibility block.
The system must display the sponsor contribution to score as a human-readable text element.
The system must position the sponsor credibility block within the trial scorecard section of the MessageBubble UI.
The system must ensure the sponsor credibility block is visually distinct from other scorecard elements using spacing or styling.
The system must render the sponsor credibility block without breaking existing MessageBubble rendering for other trial attributes.
The system must not render the sponsor credibility block if sponsor data is null or undefined.
The system must display a fallback label 'Unknown funding source' when funding source is missing.
The system must display 'No collaborators listed' when collaborator data is empty.
The system must truncate excessively long collaborator lists to a reasonable display length with indication of additional items.
The system must render all sponsor credibility fields using display-ready values produced by the transformation logic layer (ST-002).
The system must ensure the sponsor credibility component is reusable and encapsulated as a distinct subcomponent within MessageBubble.
The system must render the sponsor name prominently relative to other sponsor fields.
The system must avoid rendering raw or unformatted backend values (e.g., enums or codes) in the UI.
The system must ensure consistent typography and styling with existing MessageBubble components.
The system must render the sponsor credibility block within 100ms of MessageBubble render under normal conditions.
The system must ensure no console errors or rendering exceptions occur when sponsor data fields are partially missing.
